description: Get usage statistics for your account including message counts, spending, and live delivery health: "delivery" (liveOutbound, delivered, failed, undelivered, pending, failureRatePct) and "byNumber" (the same per sending number). A rising failure rate usually means wrong numbers, landlines, or a script retrying one recipient. Defaults to the current calendar month.

account_id.description: Your account ID. Omit it and it is resolved from your API key.

from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to start of current month.

name: get_usage
title: Get usage
